mkt.headline: Retail investors outperform S&P 500 for third consecutive year; SpaceX IPO imminent
mkt.body: Goldman Sachs' 2025 retail-favorites basket gained 30.5% vs S&P 500's 16.4%, the third straight year of outperformance. Retail concentration is in NVDA, AMZN, AppLovin, and Palantir — all high-beta tech. SpaceX IPO reportedly possible as early as next month, with SPV proliferation (170+ SpaceX SPVs since 2020) creating opaque secondary-market exposure for retail.
